newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Kings starting gold drilling programme.
newsitem.headline: Kings starting gold drilling programme.

text.p: Kings Minerals NL said it will start exploration drilling on June 12 at its wholly-owned Crystalbrook gold mining tenement in north Queensland.

Drilling is designed to test a 400 metre zone of historical mine workings, called The Silver Dollar Prospect, where rock chip sampling returned up to 9.68 grammes per tonne (g/t) gold and 39 g/t silver, Kings said.
Current drilling will test to depths of 150 metres.
"The Crystalbrook area has potential to host bulk tonnage low grade gold and/or copper deposits," Kings said.
Crystalbrook is situated 120 km west of Cairns.
